5. Statutory DMCA Notice & Takedown Procedure (17 U.S.C. § 512)

MoviePulse respects the intellectual property rights of creators and copyright owners. In compliance with the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (17 U.S.C. § 512), we maintain an expedited notice and takedown procedure for copyright holders.

How to Submit a Valid Statutory DMCA Notice

If you are a copyright owner or an authorized agent and believe that material residing on MoviePulse infringes your copyright, you must submit a written notification complying with 17 U.S.C. § 512(c)(3) containing the following mandatory elements:

  1. Authorized Signature: A physical or electronic signature of a person authorized to act on behalf of the owner of an exclusive right that is allegedly infringed.
  2. Identification of Work: Clear identification of the copyrighted work claimed to have been infringed (or a representative list if multiple works).
  3. Identification of Material: Identification of the material claimed to be infringing, including exact URLs on MoviePulse where the material is located.
  4. Contact Information: Information reasonably sufficient to permit us to contact you (legal name, physical address, telephone number, and official email address).
  5. Good Faith Statement: A statement that you have a good faith belief that use of the material in the manner complained of is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law.
  6. Perjury Statement: A statement that the information in the notification is accurate, and under penalty of perjury, that the complaining party is authorized to act on behalf of the owner of an exclusive right that is allegedly infringed.
